slides.sub: Reading the room, people-management, emotional bandwidth — the EQ season.

slides.body: Success in this phase depends less on raw output and more on how well you read people, adjust in real time, and manage the emotional temperature of a room.

slides.h2: Why this is different from Sun Dasha
slides.body: Sun Dasha asked you to be visible and hold authority. Moon Dasha asks you to be responsive — the skill isn't leading from the front, it's sensing what a situation actually needs.

points: Over-adapting until you lose your own direction
Mood swings reading as inconsistency to others
Avoiding hard calls because you're managing everyone's feelings

slides.body: Use the EQ, don't get consumed by it. People-management and reading the room are real skills this season sharpens — anchor them to a plan that doesn't change with your mood.
